objective: Sincronizador | LA ESTELAR | 23/04/2026 | Diagnosticar los 8 folios con encabezado 0 y detalle monetario que provocan RUNTIMEERROR_UNCLASSIFIED. Determinar si totaldescuentoycortesia u otros conceptos de detalle explican el cero para poder corregir solo este dia. Solo lectura.

queries.name: estelar_20260423_zero_folios_header
queries.sql:
SELECT
    ch.folio,
    ch.idturno,
    ch.fecha,
    CAST(ISNULL(ch.total,0) AS decimal(18,4)) AS total_header,
    CAST(ISNULL(ch.totaldescuentoycortesia,0) AS decimal(18,4)) AS descuento_cortesia,
    ISNULL(ch.nopersonas,0) AS pax,
    ISNULL(ch.cancelado,0) AS cancelado
FROM cheques ch WITH (NOLOCK)
WHERE ch.folio IN ('16308','16333','16343','16344','16346','16347','16348','16352')
ORDER BY ch.folio

queries.name: estelar_20260423_zero_folios_detail_summary
queries.sql:
SELECT
    dc.foliodet AS folio,
    COUNT(*) AS lineas,
    CAST(SUM(ISNULL(dc.cantidad,0)*ISNULL(dc.precio,0)) AS decimal(18,4)) AS bruto_detalle
FROM cheqdet dc WITH (NOLOCK)
WHERE dc.foliodet IN ('16308','16333','16343','16344','16346','16347','16348','16352')
GROUP BY dc.foliodet
ORDER BY dc.foliodet

queries.name: estelar_20260423_zero_folios_detail_lines
queries.sql:
SELECT
    dc.foliodet AS folio,
    COALESCE(CONVERT(varchar(100),dc.idproducto),'') AS idproducto,
    COALESCE(CONVERT(varchar(300),p.descripcion),'') AS producto,
    CAST(ISNULL(dc.cantidad,0) AS decimal(18,4)) AS cantidad,
    CAST(ISNULL(dc.precio,0) AS decimal(18,4)) AS precio,
    CAST(ISNULL(dc.cantidad,0)*ISNULL(dc.precio,0) AS decimal(18,4)) AS importe_linea
FROM cheqdet dc WITH (NOLOCK)
LEFT JOIN productos p WITH (NOLOCK)
  ON p.idproducto=dc.idproducto
WHERE dc.foliodet IN ('16308','16333','16343','16344','16346','16347','16348','16352')
ORDER BY dc.foliodet, dc.idproducto
